title: Validate the handoff done-condition command against krn task show output
body:
Outcome: the restart block's 'Done when' and 'Verify first' commands are checked by krn-handoff against the real CLI output shape before the handoff is written, so a successor never runs a done-condition that is false for a closed task.
Evidence: the session-continuity handoff carried `bin/krn task show t-1hjad4z --json | jq -e '.status == "closed"'`, which prints false after t-1hjad4z closed because the JSON nests the record under .task (correct: .task.status).
Proof: a new observer fails at the current main by assertion for a done command whose jq path does not exist in krn task show --json output, and passes at head. Coordinate with t-vq1k9mz (restart block hardening).
